description: Returns whether a domain is listed as malware or phishing on public block lists, which list says so, and where to check it and request a review. It adds HSTS preload and hacked-site signs from the latest scan; a list not read is reported as unread, never clean. Use when the only question is danger. For a go/no-go decision use preflight.
name: check_site_safety
title: Site safety check
